answer_1.quote: We generate the prediction explanation with the following template: "The patient is diagnosed as disease d because (s)he is suffering from symptom s_i, and (s)he has the vital sign of v_j, and the lab test (or PACS report) shows (s)he has t_k. Besides, s_i, v_j and t_k have been found on the patients of d for n_i, n_j, n_k times, respectively, in the previous EMR documents that support this diagnosis."
datasets: 275,797 EMR documents of two medical departments (Gynaecology and Respiration)
answer_1.outputs: Generated diagnostic explanations in natural language using predefined templates.

answer_4.quote: The explanation is evaluated by three certificated physicians.
answer_4.guideline: Physicians were asked to evaluate if the generated explanation supports the diagnosis.
